### Syntax

#### Recognized shapes

The following shapes are recognized by `ditaa`:

- **Document** `{d}`: A shape with a wavy bottom edge
- **Storage** `{s}`: A cylindrical shape (database-like)
- **Ellipse** `{o}`: An oval/ellipse shape
- **Manual operation** `{mo}`: A shape with a slanted top
- **Decision** `{c}` ("Choice"): A diamond shape
- **Trapezoid** `{tr}`: A trapezoid shape
- **Input/Output** `{io}`: A parallelogram shape

Example:

```
+--------+   
|{d}     |   
|        |   
+--------+   
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/document.png)

#### Color

`ditaa` recognizes color codes:

- `cRED` - Red
- `cGRE` - Green
- `cBLU` - Blue
- `cPNK` - Pink
- `cYEL` - Yellow
- `cBLK` - Black

Example:

```
+---------+
| cBLU    |
|         |
|    +----+
|    |cPNK|
|    |    |
+----+----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/color.png)

Common edge separation (default):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/separation.png)

No separation (with the `-E` option):

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/no_separation.png)

#### Dashed lines

Any lines that contain either at least one `=` (for horizontal lines) or at least one `:` (for vertical lines) are rendered as dashed lines. Only one of those characters can make a whole line dashed, so this feature "spreads". The rationale behind this is that you only have to change one character to switch from normal to dashed line, and vice versa.

Example:

```
----+  /----\  +----+
    :  |    |  :    |
    |  |    |  |{s} |
    v  \-=--+  +----+
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/dashed_demo.png)

#### Point markers

If `*` is encountered on a line (but not at the end of the line), it is rendered as a special marker, called the point marker. Example:

```
*----*
|    |      /--*
*    *      |
|    |  -*--+
*----*
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/point_marker.png)

#### Text handling

If the pattern ' o XXXXX' is encountered, where XXXXX is any text, the 'o' is interpreted and rendered as a bullet point. Note that there must be a space before the 'o' as well as after it.

Example:

```
/-----------------\
| Things to do    |
| cGRE            |
| o Cut the grass |
| o Buy jam       |
| o Fix car       |
| o Make website  |
\-----------------/
```

![](https://rawgit.com/stathissideris/ditaa/master/doc/images/bullet.png)

#### HTML mode

When `ditaa` is run using the `--html` option, the input is an HTML file. The contents of the `
` tags are rendered as diagrams and saved in the images directory and a new HTML file is produced with the appropriate `` tags.

If the id parameter is present in the `
` tag, its value is used as the filename of the rendered png. Otherwise a filename of the form `ditaa_diagram_X.png` is used, where X is a number.

In this mode, files that exist are not generated again, they are just skipped. You can force overwrite of the files using the `--overwrite` option.

import subprocess, os, glob

def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')

tmp="/tmp/ditaa_probe2"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
for f in glob.glob(tmp+"/*"):
    os.remove(f)
open(tmp+"/in.txt","w").write("+--+\n|  |\n+--+\n")

# test overwrite behavior
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out.png"])
print("first", repr(out), repr(err), rc)
# second without -o
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out.png"])
print("second no -o", repr(out), repr(err), rc, os.listdir(tmp))
# with -o
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out.png", "-o"])
print("with -o", repr(out), repr(err), rc)
# overwrite alt naming? Check docs: without -o alternative name chosen. Let's see files
print(os.listdir(tmp))

# test verbose with many options
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out2.png", "-v", "-A", "-d", "-E", "-r", "-S", "-W"])
print("verbose all", repr(out), rc)

# test scale verbose?
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out3.png", "-v", "-s", "2"])
print("scale verbose", repr(out), rc)
rc,out,err = run([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/out3.png", "-v", "-s", "2", "-o"])
print("scale verbose overwrite", repr(out), rc)
PY"}

{"command": "python3 <<'PY' 2>&1 | head -n 200
import subprocess, os, struct

def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')

def png_info(path):
    with open(path,'rb') as f:
        data=f.read()
    # check signature
    assert data[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', data[:8]
    # IHDR is first chunk
    length=struct.unpack('>I', data[8:12])[0]
    ctype=data[12:16]
    assert ctype==b'IHDR'
    w,h,bitdepth,colortype,comp,filt,inter = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', data[16:29])
    return w,h,bitdepth,colortype, len(data)

tmp="/tmp/ditaa_img"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
# simple test: empty file? single char?
tests = [
    ("empty", ""),
    ("newline", "\n"),
    ("single_plus", "+\n"),
    ("box_small", "+--+\n|  |\n+--+\n"),
    ("box_text", "+--------+\n|  Text  |\n+--------+\n"),
    ("larger", "+----------+\n|          |\n|          |\n|          |\n+----------+\n"),
]
for name, content in tests:
    open(f"{tmp}/{name}.txt","w").write(content)
    rc,out,err = run([f"{tmp}/{name}.txt", f"{tmp}/{name}.png", "-o"])
    print(f"{name} rc={rc} out={repr(out[-100:])} err={repr(err[:200])}")
    if os.path.exists(f"{tmp}/{name}.png"):
        try:
            w,h,bd,ct,sz = png_info(f"{tmp}/{name}.png")
            print(f"  PNG {w}x{h} bd={bd} ct={ct} size={sz}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  PNG error {e} size {os.path.getsize(f'{tmp}/{name}.png')}")
            # maybe svg? check head
            with open(f"{tmp}/{name}.png",'rb') as f:
                print(f.read(200)[:200])
    else:
        print("  no png")
PY"}

import subprocess, os, struct, zlib

def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')

def decode_png(path):
    with open(path,'rb') as f:
        data=f.read()
    assert data[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    pos=8
    idat=b''
    w=h=None
    ct=None
    bd=None
    while pos < len(data):
        length=struct.unpack('>I', data[pos:pos+4])[0]
        ctype=data[pos+4:pos+8]
        cdata=data[pos+8:pos+8+length]
        #print(ctype, length)
        if ctype==b'IHDR':
            w,h,bd,ct,comp,filt,inter = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', cdata)
        elif ctype==b'IDAT':
            idat+=cdata
        elif ctype==b'IEND':
            break
        pos+=12+length
    raw=zlib.decompress(idat)
    # each scanline has filter byte + w * bytes_per_pixel
    # ct=2 => RGB, bd=8 => 3 bytes per pixel
    ch = {0:1,2:3,3:1,4:2,6:4}[ct]
    stride = w*ch
    # unfilter (Paeth etc) - simplified: need to implement all filters
    out = bytearray()
    prev = bytearray(stride)
    p=0
    for y in range(h):
        ftype=raw[p]; p+=1
        cur=raw[p:p+stride]; p+=stride
        recon=bytearray(stride)
        if ftype==0:
            recon[:]=cur
        elif ftype==1:
            for i in range(stride):
                a=recon[i-ch] if i>=ch else 0
                recon[i]=(cur[i]+a)&0xFF
        elif ftype==2:
            for i in range(stride):
                recon[i]=(cur[i]+prev[i])&0xFF
        elif ftype==3:
            for i in range(stride):
                a=recon[i-ch] if i>=ch else 0
                recon[i]=(cur[i]+((a+prev[i])>>1))&0xFF
        elif ftype==4:
            for i in range(stride):
                a=recon[i-ch] if i>=ch else 0
                b=prev[i]
                c=prev[i-ch] if i>=ch else 0
                pp=a+b-c

The following shapes are recognized by `ditaa`:

- **Manual operation** `{mo}`: A shape with a slanted top

import subprocess

def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

# Capture all distinct error messages
import os, glob, tempfile
tmp="/tmp/ditaa_err"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
open(tmp+"/in.txt","w").write("+--+\n")

cases = [
    (["--invalid-opt"], "unrecognized long"),
    (["-z"], "unrecognized short"),
    (["-b"], "missing b"),
    (["-s"], "missing s"),
    (["-e"], "missing e"),
    (["-t"], "missing t"),
    (["--svg-font-url"], "missing svg-font-url"),
    (["-h"], "missing input with -h"),
    ([tmp+"/nonexistent.txt"], "missing file"),

    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o.png", "-b", "XYZ"], "bad bg hex"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o.png", "-b", "FFF"], "short bg"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o.png", "-e", "BADENC"], "bad encoding"),

    # java int is signed 32, but for hashing need signed? Actually HashMap uses (h = key.hashCode()) ^ (h>>>16)

def bucket(s, cap=16):

    # unsigned shift?
    # In Java, h is int, h>>>16 is logical shift
    uh = h & 0xFFFFFFFF
    spread = (h ^ (uh >> 16)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    # convert spread to signed? Actually & (n-1) uses int bits
    return spread & (cap-1)

    # tabs: int
    # Returns (grid, cols, rows, error) where error is None or 'tabs_div0' or 'empty_lines'
    has_tab = any('\t' in l for l in lines)
    if tabs == 0 and has_tab:
        return None, None, None, 'tabs_div0'
    expanded = []
    for l in lines:
        if tabs is not None and tabs > 0:
            expanded.append(l.expandtabs(tabs))
        elif tabs == 0:
            expanded.append(l)
        else:
            expanded.append(l)
    if len(expanded) > 0 and all(len(l) == 0 for l in expanded):
        return None, None, None, 'empty_lines'
    while len(expanded) > 0 and expanded[-1] == "":
        expanded.pop()
    if len(expanded) == 0:
        cols = 4
        rows = 5
        grid = ["    "] * rows
        return grid, cols, rows, None
    max_len = max(len(l) for l in expanded)
    cols = max_len + 4
    rows = len(expanded) + 4
    grid = []
    empty_row = " " * cols
    grid.append(empty_row)
    grid.append(empty_row)
    for l in expanded:
        padded = "  " + l.ljust(max_len) + "  "
        grid.append(padded)
    grid.append(empty_row)
    grid.append(empty_row)
    return grid, cols, rows, None

    h = rows * cell_h
    return w, h, cell_w, cell_h

import subprocess, os, glob, hashlib
def run_orig(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
def run_new(args):
    p = subprocess.run(["python3","src/app.py"]+args, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

tmp="/tmp/ditaa_cmp"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
open(tmp+"/in.txt","w").write("+--+\n|AB|\n+--+\n")
# clean
for f in glob.glob(tmp+"/o*.png")+glob.glob(tmp+"/n*.png"):
    try: os.remove(f)
    except: pass

for args, label in [
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o1.png", "-o"], "normal"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o2.png", "-o", "-v"], "verbose"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o3.png", "-o", "-v", "-d"], "debug"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o4.png", "-o", "-v", "-s", "2"], "scale"),
    ([tmp+"/in.txt", tmp+"/o5.svg", "-o", "--svg"], "svg"),
]:
    rc1,out1,err1 = run_orig(args)
    # need to save orig output file? It overwrites same path, so need to copy before running new
    # Actually both use same out path, second will overwrite. So run orig, save file hash, then run new, compare.
    # For now, run orig, record file, then run new separately with different out to compare banner?
    print(f"=== {label} ===")
    print(f"orig rc={rc1} out={repr(out1[:300])} err={repr(err1[:200])}")
    if os.path.exists(args[1]):
        print(f" orig file size {os.path.getsize(args[1])}")
        # save
        import shutil
        shutil.copy(args[1], args[1]+".orig")
    rc2,out2,err2 = run_new(args)
    print(f"new rc={rc2} out={repr(out2[:300])} err={repr(err2[:200])}")
    if os.path.exists(args[1]):
        print(f" new file size {os.path.getsize(args[1])}")
    print(f"banner same? {out1==out2} rc same? {rc1==rc2}")
    print()

import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/app.py").read_text()
# Fix SVG: omit rect for 8-digit
old_svg = """    transparent=behavior.get('transparent', False)
    background=behavior.get('background')
    if not transparent:
        if background is None:
            bg_str="#ffffff"
        else:
            bg_val=background
            if bg_val>0xFFFFFF:
                bg_str=f"#{(bg_val & 0xFFFFFFFF):08x}"
            else:
                bg_str=f"#{(bg_val & 0xFFFFFF):06x}"
        lines.append(f"    <rect x='0' y='0' width='{w}' height='{h}' style='fill: {bg_str}'/>")"""
new_svg = """    transparent=behavior.get('transparent', False)
    background=behavior.get('background')
    # For SVG, 8-digit backgrounds (with transparency) omit rect (like transparent)
    if not transparent and not (background is not None and background>0xFFFFFF):
        if background is None:
            bg_str="#ffffff"
        else:
            bg_val=background
            bg_str=f"#{(bg_val & 0xFFFFFF):06x}"
        lines.append(f"    <rect x='0' y='0' width='{w}' height='{h}' style='fill: {bg_str}'/>")"""
if old_svg in p:
    p = p.replace(old_svg, new_svg)
    print("svg fixed")
else:
    print("svg not found")
# Fix PNG write: handle 8-digit background as RGBA
old_png = """    if transparent:
        ch=4
        buf=bytearray(width*height*4)
        is_rgba=True
    else:
        ch=3
        if background is None:
            bg=(255,255,255)
        else:
            bg_val=background
            if bg_val>0xFFFFFF:
                r=(bg_val>>16)&0xFF; g=(bg_val>>8)&0xFF; b=bg_val&0xFF
                bg=(r,g,b)
            else:
                r=(bg_val>>16)&0xFF; g=(bg_val>>8)&0xFF; b=bg_val&0xFF
                bg=(r,g,b)
        buf=bytearray(width*height*3)
        for i in range(width*height):
            buf[i*3]=bg[0]; buf[i*3+1]=bg[1]; buf[i*3+2]=bg[2]
        is_rgba=False"""
new_png = """    # 8-digit background means semi-transparent (RGBA)
    is_8bit_bg = (background is not None and background>0xFFFFFF)
    if transparent or is_8bit_bg:
        ch=4
        buf=bytearray(width*height*4)
        is_rgba=True
        if transparent:
            # fully transparent (0,0,0,0) already zeros
            pass
        else:
            # 8-digit: AARRGGBB
            a=(background>>24)&0xFF; r=(background>>16)&0xFF; g=(background>>8)&0xFF; b=background&0xFF
            for i in range(width*height):
                buf[i*4]=r; buf[i*4+1]=g; buf[i*4+2]=b; buf[i*4+3]=a
    else:
        ch=3
        if background is None:
            bg=(255,255,255)
        else:
            bg_val=background
            r=(bg_val>>16)&0xFF; g=(bg_val>>8)&0xFF; b=bg_val&0xFF
            bg=(r,g,b)
        buf=bytearray(width*height*3)
        for i in range(width*height):
            buf[i*3]=bg[0]; buf[i*3+1]=bg[1]; buf[i*3+2]=bg[2]
        is_rgba=False"""
if old_png in p:
    p = p.replace(old_png, new_png)
    print("png fixed")
else:
    print("png not found")
pathlib.Path("src/app.py").write_text(p)
print("done")
